description: React component for displaying and managing installed slash commands in Mattermost, including features like filtering, token regeneration, editing, and deletion.

classes.name: InstalledCommand
classes.description: React component class for rendering an installed slash command with management options.

methods.name: matchesFilter
methods.description: Filters commands based on display name, description, or trigger matching the filter string.

methods.name: handleRegenToken
methods.description: Handles token regeneration button click, calls onRegenToken prop.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Handles delete action, calls onDelete prop.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the component UI, including command details, actions, and filtering logic.
